effects.does: Clicking it opens Clara for help with generating or reviewing the event.
effects.affects: It may use the event's line items as input for an AI RFP request.

effects.affects: It adds attachment data to the event configuration.
effects.check: Click Add Attachments and verify that a file-selection control appears.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the terms-and-conditions editor.
effects.affects: It changes the event's terms and conditions, including clauses or attachments.
effects.check: Click Add T&Cs and verify that the terms editor opens.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the event's two-item line-item view or editor.
effects.affects: It exposes the line items that are saved in the event payload.
effects.check: Verify that clicking Items 2 displays two event line items.

effects.does: Clicking it saves the current event as a draft.
effects.affects: It creates or updates the draft event record and preserves draft stage and line-item data.

effects.check: Click Save as draft, reload the event, and verify that the entered data remains and the event is still a draft.

effects.does: Clicking it validates and publishes the RFQ event.
effects.affects: It changes the event or project from draft toward an active published state and may create or update its stages.
effects.leadsTo: Published event or event details screen
effects.check: With all required data and at least one participant entered, click Publish and verify that the event is created successfully.

effects.does: Clicking it selects or opens the RFQ event mode.
effects.affects: It determines that this stage uses request-for-quotation behavior rather than another event mode.
effects.check: Verify that RFQ is shown as the active event mode after selection.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the template selector for choosing a buy template.
effects.affects: It changes the template and can replace the fields and configuration available in the pricing sheet.
effects.check: Choose a different template and verify that the template fields or configuration change.

effects.does: Clicking it opens controls for adding or configuring pricing-sheet columns.
effects.affects: It changes the fields or columns shown for each event line item.
effects.check: Add a column and verify that it appears in the pricing sheet.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the event details section.
effects.affects: It changes the visible configuration area but does not by itself change event data.
effects.check: Click Details and verify that event-detail fields are displayed.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the price-components configuration.
effects.affects: It changes how the event's price is broken into component fields or calculations.
effects.check: Click Price Components and verify that price-component controls are displayed.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the vendor invitation control.
effects.affects: It adds selected vendor companies to the event audience or participant list.
effects.check: Select an eligible vendor and verify that the vendor appears in the participant list.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the event participant list and management controls.
effects.affects: It changes the event's audience participants when vendors are added or removed.
effects.check: Open Participants and verify that the current invited-vendor list is shown.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the savings configuration or summary.
effects.affects: It changes or displays savings data associated with the event.
effects.check: Scroll to Savings, click it, and verify that savings fields or values are displayed.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the terms-and-conditions section.
effects.affects: It changes the clauses and attachments stored for the event's terms and conditions.
effects.check: Click Terms & Conditions and verify that the configured clauses or attachments are shown.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the event schedule control showing the start time, end time, and duration.
effects.affects: It changes the stage schedule and therefore when vendors can respond.
effects.check: Open the schedule control and verify that the displayed 30-minute timing can be edited.

effects.does: Clicking it selects the Technical Stage tab.
effects.affects: It changes the active stage being configured without changing event data by itself.
effects.check: Click Technical Stage and verify that its fields and configuration are displayed.

effects.does: Clicking it selects or keeps the RFQ stage active.
effects.affects: It changes the active stage context to the RFQ stage without changing data by itself.

effects.check: Verify that RFQ remains visually selected and its pricing-sheet fields are shown.

effects.does: Clicking it navigates to the Events list.
effects.affects: Nothing in the current event data.
effects.check: Click Events and verify that the event list opens.

effects.affects: It changes the title saved on the event or project record and used in later confirmation and navigation.

Drawer disabled when fromPR, `isEditingAllowed=false` or `isAddNewStage`; variant shows "Variant of product cannot be modified", quantity/unit " 'Quantity Requested' and 'Unit of Measurement' cannot be modified" (quantity still editable when fromPR) — src/views/projectCreation/components/projectLine

Shown only when not RFQ→Auction, `allow_draft_project_creation` on, not (service-RFP grouping AND `groupServiceActivitiesInRfp`), auctions not routed to the auction team, and the current stage is not recurring — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:292-296, 3343-3345

cases.title: Add Columns opens the column selection control
cases.expected: A column selection or configuration panel opens for the pricing sheet.

steps.note: Open the eRFX create screen containing the pricing sheet controls.
Provide the required project title for a create-screen test.
Apply a pricing template so the pricing sheet and its column controls are available.
Add a line item to render the pricing sheet.
Open the pricing-sheet column selection control.
Verify that the column selection or configuration panel opened.
